title: Where to buy baby things/register for online shower?
label: gear

posts.body: Hi there, just relocated from the States to HK, due in July. My friends back home want to do a virtual baby shower for me. Is there an online site here in HK that I can register for items and they can use to purchase? Any insite on where one goes to buy all the essentials would be great as well, i have NO idea. I've heard of Bumps to Babes, but the website is NOT helpful. Need to get basics like breast pump, crib, etc. I brought over car sear and stroller from the states.

posts.body:
You can create a wishlist on ShopinHK.Com and email it to all your friends.

http://www.shopinhk.com/baby-shop/

You'll find Grobags, toys, diaper bags and lots of baby books to start baby's first library.

posts.body:
I can't help you with the shower issue, but you'll find the Central branch of Bumps2Babes in Pedder Building (5/F) on Pedder Street. Mothercare also has a branch in Central (Prince's Building).

Posted via Mobile Device

posts.body: why not use a wish list site like wishpot http://www.wishpot.com/ where you can add all the various items from stores here and abroad. your US friends could also do a groups shipment which will be much cheaper for everyone. Or they can research the flat rate boxes to limit the size. Good luck!
